name: starting architecture
last_analysis: No scores are visible, so the evidence is only that every design trained without error and stayed within the time limit. The final pick will go to the highest 2-seed dev score. Since this is the last round, the most useful candidates are strong combinations of ideas that each had a sound reason behind them. Those ideas are: more fresh samples (fewer PPO epochs), a longer credit horizon for the bonus that arrives only at episode end, global context, and the per-layer footprint head that matches how bricks land. The global-context trunk is the cheapest network (about 1.04x compute), so it can see the most data. The per-layer head is the best match to the task's structure but has never been tested with a longer horizon or with any spatial mixing inside each layer. I propose: (1) the 1-epoch global-context net plus gamma 0.98; (2) the per-layer head plus gamma 0.98; (3) the per-layer head plus a 3x3 convolution inside each layer, so it can see neighbouring support and overhang structure at that layer.
